surfaces.name: context-rules
surfaces.why: Always-loaded rules are a budget; they must stay short and every rule must link the file that owns the detail.

surfaces.name: plan-docs
evidence: read the changed section as its reader: does it still state current behaviour, and does its scope still match PLAN.md?
surfaces.why: The plan is the single source of product scope and architecture; documentation edits are behaviour changes for the next agent.

surfaces.name: decisions
evidence: read Alternatives considered yourself; a gate cannot judge it
surfaces.why: A decision without what it rejected invites re-litigation.

surfaces.name: agent-skills
evidence: read the skill description as the loader: does it name when the skill applies, not what it contains?
surfaces.why: A skill is loaded by its description and carries the writing procedure. Without its four sections, trigger-shaped description, and resolvable links, the procedure is an article nobody can reach or trust.

surfaces.name: source
surfaces.why: Behaviour changes need the narrowest owning check; for dsh-cowork that is typecheck plus build until the M0 probe establishes real E2E lanes.

surfaces.name: tests
evidence: watch the owning test fail for the regression it pins
surfaces.why: A test is evidence only when its command and its failure mode are named.

surfaces.name: packaging
surfaces.why: Manifests and lockfiles change the shipped artifact, not just the source.

surfaces.name: publication
evidence: read the changed document as its reader: does its kind, budget, and publication class still match its content?
surfaces.why: A file existing is not a file shipping. Every Markdown file must be classified exactly once in docs/publish.json; documentation edits are behaviour changes for the next reader and the next agent.

surfaces.name: workflow
surfaces.why: A guard is only real if a violation makes it red; the workflow surface proves the guards can fail.

surfaces.name: drill
surfaces.why: The v1-to-v2 migration drill is the only executable proof of backup byte equality, second-write idempotence and backup rollback; changing the drill changes that evidence.

checks.why: Always-loaded context is a budget, not a dumping ground. This root file is capped at 120 lines; directory-bound rules move into that directory's own AGENTS.md.

The documentation standard needs one home, and that home needs a shape. Without kinds, placement, tutorial/reference, link/mirror/generate, budgets, publication, the slop checklist, and known limits, a page has no rule to be held to.
The documentation standard is standing context, so it is a word budget. Relocate, then condense, then raise the number and say why.
The testing strategy needs one home, and that home needs tiers, commands, determinism, lane severity, flake disposition, and the evidence map.
The testing policy is standing context on every test change, so it carries a ceiling.
A record home without when-to-write, the class set, and the lifecycle flow cannot route a new decision.
The record rules are standing context for every decision record, so they carry a ceiling.
The glossary is the vocabulary home, so how to read it and what earns a term must stay stated.
The human-facing half of the vocabulary layer must keep both the lookup rule and the expansion rule.
Reference pages are looked up, not read whole, so each carries a ceiling.
A term heading is an identifier; a translated heading would break anchor-based links into the entry.
A skill with no trigger, rule, verification step, or named failure mode is an article nobody opens.
A skill is loaded by its description, so the description must open with a load trigger rather than a summary of the skill's contents.
Every document is deliberately public or internal; an unclassified file is a silent omission, and a public entry with no file behind it is a broken promise.
Agent-loaded files and entry indexes must not cite files that do not exist; a reader follows a broken pointer and finds nothing.
A moved record that keeps proposal-era headings reads as an active plan; the skeleton must be rewritten, not appended to.
Committed conflict markers are unresolved merge residue.
A repository file must not carry an obvious credential or private key.
Documented tests and examples must not prescribe fixed sleeps as readiness.
A retronym list: each entry is a spelling this repository has stopped using, and a ban is added only after the corpus is clean.
Record families live under docs/handoffs/ or docs/archived/{handoffs,results,recon}/; root docs hold rules, project documents, and standalone files.
